title: Flock agreement, Policy 463 versions, Flock Committee records
summary: Baseline document request: the current Flock agreement and amendments, prior versions of Policy 463 (the ALPR policy), SOP 205, and any records of the 'Flock Committee' roundtable referenced in agency documents. Produced the August 2023 MSA + Amendment No. 1, Policy 463 (Dec 2025), SOP 205 (Nov 2025), and three Pak calendar entries. The response stated 'no responsive records' for Flock Committee meeting minutes, agendas, notes, or summaries.
filed_because: Baseline document set for the investigation. Establishes which policies and contracts are in force, what amendments exist, and what records document the internal committee structure referenced in agency materials.
notes: The 'no responsive records' answer on Flock Committee meeting minutes/agendas/notes is one of several inputs to later follow-up PRAs probing committee governance.
